title: hashCode/equals in action
prompt: Inside `Solution`, write `static java.util.HashSet<String> dedupe(java.util.List<String> words)` returning a HashSet of the distinct words. Then write `record Slug(String raw)` whose compact constructor lowercases and trims the raw value — so that `new Slug("  A ")` equals `new Slug("a")` and both collapse to one entry in a HashSet.

tests.name: normalized record collapses
tests.hint: The compact constructor normalizes BEFORE equals/hashCode use it.
